+"""String utility functions."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+
+def slugify(text: str) -> str:
+    """Convert text to a URL-safe slug.
+
+    >>> slugify('Hello World!')
+    'hello-world'
+    """
+    import re
+    text = text.lower().strip()
+    text = re.sub(r'[^\w\s-]', '', text)
+    text = re.sub(r'[-\s]+', '-', text)
+    return text
+
